facts.fact: 祭坛一吻的记忆：预想的糖味落空，舌头上是暗香料与纯粹毒液——冰层下的火。
facts.anchor: my tongue caught the sharp, fiery tang of dark spice and pure, unadulterated venom

facts.fact: Magnus 专程道谢：顶替成婚救了 pack 联盟，也救了他和 Nell。
facts.anchor: you saved the pack alliance, Gunnar. You saved me and Nell.

facts.fact: Magnus 压低声音警告：对她好点、别出轨——这句话像友军流弹击中 Gunnar。
facts.anchor: "Just be good to her, G. And don't cheat."

facts.fact: 他的双手是十年执法练出的刑具；兄弟们的顾虑让他意识到所有人眼里他只有刽子手。
facts.anchor: Hands trained to find the exact pressure point to snap a femur or shatter a collarbone.

facts.fact: 母亲的「so proud」是他的锚——brute 说到底也是妈妈的儿子。
facts.anchor: Making her proud was the anchor that kept my wolf grounded.

facts.fact: 连母亲都警告他新娘被 Sorsha 藏了一辈子、娇弱需万般温柔——他的 finesse 被全家打折。
facts.anchor: Sorsha has kept that poor girl sheltered her whole life.

facts.fact: 闪电般的醒悟：她不只是柔弱无邪，大概率还是处女。
facts.anchor: Fuck. She wasn't just weak and innocent. She was likely a virgin.

facts.fact: Addie 的忠告核心：被塞进包办婚姻的女孩，把身体的控制权还给她是最好的礼物。
facts.anchor: Giving her control over her own body when she's been thrown into an arranged marriage is the greatest gift you can give her.

facts.fact: 章末悬念：一个男狼贴得太近地站在他妻子身边。
facts.anchor: There was a male wolf next to her.
